# Sirach Chapter 46 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 46 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**46:1** Joshua son of Nun was mighty in war and was the successor of Moses in the prophetic office; he was, as his name declares, a great salvation for his people — appointed for vengeance on the enemies that rose against them — so that he might give Israel its inheritance.

**46:2** How glorious he was when he lifted up his hand and brandished his sword against the cities!

**46:3** Who before him had stood so firm? For he himself fought the wars of the Lord.

**46:4** Was it not by his hand that the sun stood still, so that one day became as long as two?

**46:5** He called upon the Most High, the Mighty One, when enemies pressed him hard on every side; and the great Lord answered him with hailstones of overpowering force.

**46:6** He overwhelmed a nation in battle, and on the descent he utterly destroyed his opponents, so that the nations might know his full armor — that he was fighting in the presence of the Lord; for he followed the Mighty One.

**46:7** And in the days of Moses also he performed a deed of loyal love — he and Caleb son of Jephunneh — in standing firm against the congregation, in restraining the people from sin, and in putting an end to their wicked murmuring.

**46:8** And of six hundred thousand infantry, those two alone were preserved to lead them into their heritage, into a land flowing with milk and honey.

**46:9** And the Lord gave Caleb strength, and strength remained with him to old age, so that he went up to the hill country of the land, and his descendants received it as their inheritance,

**46:10** so that all the children of Israel might see how good it is to follow the Lord.

**46:11** And the judges also — each one by name — all those whose hearts did not turn to idolatry and who did not turn away from the Lord — may their memory be blessed!

**46:12** May their bones sprout anew from where they lie, and may the honored name of those men live again in their sons.

**46:13** Samuel was beloved of the Lord; a prophet of the Lord, he established the kingdom and anointed rulers over his people.

**46:14** By the law of the Lord he judged the congregation, and the Lord kept watch over Jacob.

**46:15** By his faithfulness he was attested as a prophet, and by his words he was trusted as a seer.

**46:16** He called upon the Mighty Lord when enemies pressed him in on every side, as he offered a suckling lamb as a sacrifice.

**46:17** And the Lord thundered from heaven and made his great voice heard with a mighty sound.

**46:18** He crushed the commanders of the enemy and destroyed all the rulers of the Philistines.

**46:19** Before the time of his eternal sleep, he called the Lord and his anointed to witness: "I have taken no man's property, not so much as a pair of sandals" — and no one accused him.

**46:20** Even after he had fallen asleep he prophesied; he revealed to the king his impending death, and lifted up his voice from the earth in prophecy, to blot out the wickedness of the people.
